intent: Compare the modeled supply, demand, and price levels across the quantity range.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
Compare the modeled supply, demand, and price levels across the quantity range.
In the single panel, the DEMAND series decreases monotonically from 1.0000 at point_order 1 to 0.0000 at point_order 40 as quantity increases.
Where do the SUPPLY and DEMAND series cross, and what is the approximate crossing level?

units.claim: All 2 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: In the single panel, the SUPPLY series increases monotonically from 0.0000 at point_order 1 to 1.0000 at point_order 40 as quantity increases.
units.computation: Compare first and last values of SUPPLY: 0.0000 to 1.0000; intermediate sampled points are non-decreasing.
accept: SUPPLY rises from 0 to 1 across the quantity range

units.claim: In the single panel, the DEMAND series decreases monotonically from 1.0000 at point_order 1 to 0.0000 at point_order 40 as quantity increases.
units.computation: Compare first and last values of DEMAND: 1.0000 to 0.0000; intermediate sampled points are non-increasing.
accept: DEMAND falls from 1 to 0 across the quantity range

units.claim: In the single panel, SUPPLY and DEMAND cross once between point_order 27 and 28, at approximately point_order 27.55 and relative value 0.5000. SUPPLY is below DEMAND at point_order 27 and above DEMAND at point_order 28.
units.computation: At point_order 26: SUPPLY=0.4430 < DEMAND=0.5570. At point_order 27: SUPPLY=0.4789 < DEMAND=0.5211. At point_order 28: SUPPLY=0.5170 > DEMAND=0.4830. Linear interpolation gives an intersection at 27 + 0.0422/(0.0422+0.0340) = 27.554, with both values approximately 0.5000.
accept: SUPPLY and DEMAND cross once between adjacent plotted points 27 and 28.
SUPPLY is 0.4789 versus DEMAND 0.5211 at point_order 27.
SUPPLY is 0.5170 versus DEMAND 0.4830 at point_order 28.
The approximate crossing is at point_order 27.55 and relative value 0.5000.
reject: Claims that the series cross at point_order 25.
Uses 0.4080 and 0.5920 as the crossing values.
Claims that SUPPLY remains below DEMAND through point_order 28.

optional_valid: The price level at the crossing is approximately 0.5 relative units.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanation of why supply and demand cross
Exact equilibrium price or quantity beyond the sampled points
Comparison across multiple panels (only one panel exists)
review_notes: The intent asks to compare supply, demand, and price levels across the quantity range; the three units capture the two trends and their crossing.
No separate price-level series exists; price level is the y-axis value of the supply and demand curves.
